applicationProfile.reason: The ticket system requires server-side authoritative data shared across users (submitters, handlers, admins) with company-level multi-tenant isolation, role-based authorization, email notification integration, auto-assignment background processing, and cross-user statistics aggregation. These are all explicit server-side capabilities that cannot be satisfied by a browser-only frontend.

supporting: 工单按公司隔离，A公司用户无法看到B公司工单 — requires server-side tenant isolation and authoritative data
工单分配需要多个角色协作（提交人、处理人、管理员）— requires cross-user shared data on the server
工单完成后发送邮件通知提交人 — requires external email service integration
按分类自动分配到业务组 — requires server-side background processing and rules engine
统计分析仪表盘：工单量、平均响应时间、满意度、热点问题 — requires server-side aggregation across all tickets
操作日志记录关键操作（操作人、操作时间、操作类型）— requires persistent server-side audit logging
